about: Burst 31 (group B, B-B2) golden for harness/visit-anatomy.mjs after the single-line depWalk anchor (T1) and the extraction of the counter map + instrument() into harness/visit-anchors.mjs (T4). Commands: node harness/visit-anatomy.mjs (-> visit-anatomy.txt) and node harness/visit-anatomy.mjs --verify (-> visit-anatomy-verify.txt), run from the repo root of a tree whose Signal.js is the f29k3 kernel; capture rule: `node T args > f 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> f` (stdout+stderr merged into a file, never a pipe, then an exit=<n> line). Nothing is stripped: the tool is untimed and line 2 carries only content hashes (engine sha256 + instrumented-copy sha256), so the capture is byte-stable. Golden cut from the frozen scratch tree g1 (T1 tool + f29k3 kernel), two runs per mode, cmp-identical.
